title: ERA5 calendar-day climatology preparation
purpose: Prepare 1991-2020 calendar-day climatology fields for ERA5 anomaly and composite analysis
input_data: Step 9B standardized ERA5 daily 00 UTC files
calendar_day_method: Mean for each MM-DD calendar day using available 1991-2020 samples
temporal_resolution: daily 00 UTC fields, not daily means
important_notes: This step creates climatology files only; full anomaly files are not written to save storage.
Anomalies will be computed during event-composite extraction by subtracting the matching MM-DD climatology.
Leap day, 02-29, is retained using available leap-year samples from 1991-2020.
The same 1991-2020 baseline is consistent with the BMD percentile baseline used in the station analysis.
